notes: Maine Learning Results: Science, Technology, and Engineering standards (2019). Maine adopted NGSS-based standards. Comprehensive document available but in DOCX (Word) format, not PDF. Maine also provides individual grade-band documents as separate PDF/DOCX files.
issues_encountered: Maine does not provide a single comprehensive PDF - only Word document (.docx) or separate grade-band documents
Returns HTML instead of PDF when accessing through automated tools
alternative_approach: Maine provides separate grade-band documents in PDF format if Word document is not acceptable
